headline: As of 2026-10-06: 1,622,726 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 32 of 50 states, D+31.4 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 1,622,726 early/mail ballots cast so far across 32 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+31.4 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Virginia (387,232), Florida (243,151), New Jersey (206,464).
